cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Apologize for the Lie
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge that the concealment or misdirection mattered, even if the underlying choice was defensible.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. I'm not asking you to apologise for cancelling. Apologise for not telling me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I didn't want to upset you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. So you let me arrive with a cake instead.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm sorry the party didn't happen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Try the part where I didn't know.
